producer_report.summary: The merged tree has no conflict markers. In CHANGELOG.md and producer.rs I kept both the branch tip's text and the candidate's. Producer `cargo build`, `test`, `clippy` and `check` take a build slot through an `athena` symlink named `cargo` that comes first on the producer PATH. The subcommand is found after the global flags, using the one shared list in policy.rs. A wait past the limit prints the documented message, exits 75, writes a note, and the job is held, not failed. This round I also widened the hold wording for a producer-stage hold, which has no kept candidate. That edits the `hold_for_slot_wait` doc in close.rs and the `go` message in run/mod.rs. I ran the targeted tests, fmt and clippy, and they pass; I did not run the full suite, which Athena runs.

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p xtask --test ci_shards -p xtask --test policy

checks_run.note: run before the last two doc and message edits

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: the slot_exec tests pass, including one with one slot and two producer processes where the second blocks while the first holds the slot, then runs, and afterwards try_acquire succeeds.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test slot_exec`: 5 passed, including a_second_producer_cargo_waits_for_the_slot_then_runs. I did not run the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: a test runs `cargo -q build` and `cargo --locked test` through the wrapper against a fake cargo and asserts both held a slot while running and freed it after; it fails if the subcommand lookup reads only args[0].
criteria_check.evidence: global_flags_before_the_subcommand_still_hold_a_slot passes in the same run. slot_exec.rs takes the subcommand from policy::cargo_subcommand, which skips the global flags.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: a test where no slot frees within the wait limit asserts the documented message ('no build slot free for ... s; try again'), a non-failure environment exit, and that the job is recorded as held, not failed; the real cargo is never started.
criteria_check.evidence: a_wait_past_the_limit_exits_75_and_never_starts_cargo passes (exit 75, message, fake cargo not started, note written). The core test a_producer_whose_last_cargo_waited_out_the_slot_holds_the_job passes in `cargo test -p athena-core --lib -- slots run::tests`.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`: a test shows `cargo fmt` and `cargo metadata` run through the wrapper without taking a slot even when every slot is held.
Run `cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards`: checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit passes. Grep shows xtask/shard-timings.txt has an `athena-cli --test slot_exec` line.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test --locked -p xtask --test ci_shards`: 20 passed, including checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit. The git diff shows the added shard-timings line. mirrors test also passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test --locked` from the repo root on the merged tree: all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt --check and clippy -D warnings clean, and targeted tests, but not the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: CARGO_GLOBAL_FLAGS in crates/athena-agent/src/policy.rs is the single shared list, Grep shows the wrapper uses it, and no second copy exists; check_cargo behavior is unchanged and its existing tests pass.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep of crates/ for CARGO_GLOBAL_FLAGS shows one definition (policy.rs:479), used by cargo_subcommand and check_cargo. slot_exec.rs calls policy::cargo_subcommand. `cargo test -p athena-agent --lib` passes, including the agreement test.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs puts the wrapper directory first on the producer PATH only; the diff leaves verifier commands and environments unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: env.rs only adds CargoShim and its helpers, and `build` is unchanged. The tests build_adds_no_shim_variables and only_the_producer_gets_the_cargo_shim_first_on_path pass.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for producer cargo commands taking a build slot. The diff touches no governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) and no records/.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md line 98 has the entry. `git status` lists no athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflow or records/ path. No conflict markers remain in any file.

open_issues: The wrapper keeps the verified candidate's nested-cargo handling (the real cargo's PATH lacks the shim directory), not the plan's ATHENA_SLOT_HELD guard; the brief says to keep the verified candidate. A cargo started by the real cargo is the real one and cannot wait on its parent's slot.
Findings 2 and 3 of the old job are kept as documented trade-offs. A later command leaves the wait note, so the job stays held; SIGKILL of the wrapper frees the slot while the child may still run.
I ran clippy before the last two edits (comment in close.rs and message text in mod.rs). fmt --check was clean after them. Athena reruns both.
mistakes: The earlier round left close.rs and the go message in run/mod.rs unchanged although the plan widened their hold wording. I changed both this time.
learnings: The merge was already resolved in the working copy: no conflict marker lines remain in CHANGELOG.md or crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs, and both hold the tip's text plus the candidate's.
